{{quotation|[[Scholar Glenna (Bastion of the Penitent)|Scholar Glenna]]|History is like a pair of dice—many-sided and loaded with chance. Every story has multiple angles. Most of us just accept what we're taught, but that can be dangerous.}}
[[Scholar Glenna]] is a [[Durmand Priory]] scholar, who serves as a vendor for [[Magnetite Shard]]s in every [[raid]]. The associated raid encounter must be completed before you can buy its items from her. She also offers to buy any raid-themed miniature for 40 Magnetite Shards.

== Biography ==
=== [[Spirit Vale]] ===
Interested in historical and [[magic]]al findings, Glenna joined the ranks of the [[Durmand Priory]]. Having heard gossip among her fellow scholars of strange magic phenomena in northern parts of the [[Heart of Maguuma]] which had begun occurring after the [[Elder Dragon]] [[Mordremoth]]'s [[Hearts and Minds|demise]] in 1328 <small>[[Mouvelian calendar|AE]]</small>, she set out to investigate the jungle.<ref name="Field Journal">[[Glenna's Field Journal]]</ref>

After entering [[Spirit Vale]], Glenna happened upon a [[Pact]] camp full of demoralized and injured soldiers from the Maguuma campaign who were recovering from a [[bandit]] raid which had resulted in several kidnappings. She did what she could to comfort them, being unable to do much else because the dangers in the jungle were too great for any of them to overcome. In the meantime she began writing a [[Glenna's Field Journal|field journal]]. She also investigated strange [[Ley Rift|ley rift]]s and [[Rift Forger|mastered]] traversing through them safely.

When a group of mercenaries and the [[Pact Commander]] answered the Pact's call for help, Glenna acted as a merchant to these raiders, selling them various useful items in exchange for [[Magnetite Shard|magnetite shards]]. During these interactions she also heard the raiders' tales of what they had encountered in the jungle, which piqued her interest.

=== [[Salvation Pass]] ===
Once the raiders had cleared the obstacles in Spirit Vale and defeated [[Sabetha the Saboteur]] who had been leading the bandits, Glenna journeyed westward to [[Salvation Pass]] where she set up shop to offer supplies to other adventurers seeking to uncover the secrets of the pass, including what the bandits, who had been kidnapping people, were up to. She followed the trail of brave adventurers who had fought a safe passage through the jungle, and discovered the corpse of [[Slothasor]] which she theorized had been mutated from the magical fallout of Mordremoth's death.

Pressing onward, Glenna passed through an abandoned bandit fort which the raiders had cleared as well as a mass of bodies thrown off the cliff. What caught her eye was a deactivated [[asura gate]] leading [[Fort Vandal|somewhere]] in [[Brisban Wildlands]], raising more questions than answers in her mind. She met with the recently freed Pact squad leader, [[Squad Leader Bennett|Bennett]], who revealed to her the ordeals he had been through in the hands of the bandits who the raiders had saved him from. The bandits had turned out to be working for [[Matthias Gabrel]] and the [[White Mantle]] cult in preparation for something big involving macabre sacrifices with the Maguuma [[Bloodstone]]. Although Matthias had been slain by the raiders, more cultists still lurked deeper in the jungle. Glenna began theorizing about the White Mantle's goals and what part the Bloodstone played in it and decided to investigate further, traveling to the White Mantle's base of power in the region, the [[Stronghold of the Faithful]].

During her investigations in the [[Forsaken Thicket]], Glenna encountered an anomaly and threw a rock at it to test what would happen. The rock passed through the anomaly unaffected, prompting Glenna to conduct more experiments which revealed that the anomaly was like a window to other places, showing glimpses of figures through the mist.<ref name="Field Journal" />

=== [[Stronghold of the Faithful]] ===
Angered by the White Mantle's reign of terror and the horrors their hundreds of captives had been going through over the decades, Glenna continued her journey westward, this time reaching the outskirts of the Stronghold of the Faithful whose intimidating gates and sentries prevented deeper exploration. While scouting the area, she updated her field journal and would allow any passing ally to read her notes to better understand what had been transpiring in the thicket. She also [[Love Is Bunny|adopted a lovesick rabbit]].

Meeting up with the raiders who had come to help siege the stronghold, Glenna decided to take a more proactive approach than before to end the White Mantle's threat to the jungle and Tyria as a whole, and volunteered to accompany the raiders on their mission. She had crafted custom bombs made from her own blend of black powder, magnetite shards, and a few other compounds. The bombs' resulting shrapnel blast would shatter everything in range, including any magical barriers. When the raiders asked if they could carry some bombs, she denied them the pleasure: according to her, the bombs were highly unstable and would explode from the slightest bump, so they would need an expert like her to handle them.<ref>[[Scholar Glenna (Stronghold of the Faithful)#Dialogue]]</ref> Due to carrying the bombs, however, she required an escort to keep her safe. Some raiders were less than pleased about escort duty as none volunteered for it but eventually they managed to settle the matter and escort Glenna to the gates. The more playful raiders would tease her by constantly ordering her to hurry to them, leading to Glenna's rising frustration and her eventually snapping that she was not their puppy. She did get her revenge on the raiders, however, by stating that she would call for them if she ever needed expert lever pullers.

As the raiders advanced deeper into the stronghold, Glenna instructed them to use the ley lines and rifts created from Mordremoth's death to bypass White Mantle defenses and defeat the defenders. Upon reaching the courtyard, they faced the [[Keep Construct]] summoned by [[Xera]], the High Inquisitor who Matthias Gabrel and Sabetha the Saboteur had been working for. In a prideful taunt, Xera and her minions had accidentally revealed that the cult was planning to resurrect [[Lazarus]], the purported last [[mursaat]], whom the White Mantle had once worshipped as the Unseen Ones. Glenna was unsure how Xera was going to accomplish the task, however, and if Lazarus even was in the stronghold to begin with, although she speculated that the cult would try to use the magic within bloodstone shards to aid in the ritual.

Upon the construct's defeat, Xera's [[mesmer]] magic, amplified by consumed bloodstone shards, turned the stronghold into the [[Twisted Castle]], a maze the raiders would have to navigate as she attempted to stall them from pursuit to finish the resurrection ritual. Glenna used the opportunity to inform the raiders of what she knew as well as her many theories, letting them know about the significance of bloodstone and how it tied to mursaat, [[titan]]s, and sacrifices.

While the raiders battled Xera, Glenna investigated the courtyard and discovered various artifacts and books that revealed or hinted at intriguing information about the cult's actions. Upon the High Inquisitor's defeat, Glenna congratulated the raiders and suggested that they investigate the chamber below where they found an empty stasis chamber, unsure if Lazarus had been killed or if he had successfully revived and escaped. Glenna tried to lighten the troubled mood by showing sympathy towards Salvation Pass's Slothasor which, according to her, had just wanted a hug, leading to an awkward moment between her and the raiders who were unsure how to react to her words.

=== [[Bastion of the Penitent]] ===
In 1330 <small>AE</small>, Glenna traveled to the crater which had once held the Maguuma Bloodstone in [[Bloodstone Fen]] and discovered a strange portal within. After venturing through it, she found herself in a cave which led to a wider area containing what she identified as the mursaat's [[Cairn the Indomitable|jade construct]] above which floated a smaller pyramid shaped construct which she recognized from history books as the [[Eye of Janthir]]. Believing that the constructs would not have been placed there unless they were meant to guard a location containing potential treasure or at least discoveries of historical importance, she sent word to the raiders who hurried to her location.<ref>[[Scholar Glenna (Bastion of the Penitent)#Dialogue]]</ref>

Once the raiders had defeated the jade construct guarding the entrance, they and Glenna witnessed the Eye fleeing deeper into the cave as the scholar explained the Eye's significance in the Bloodstone sacrifices performed by the mursaat and the White Mantle in the past. As they pursued the pyramid construct, they came across what appeared to be an intimidating fortress at first glance. Upon finding a way inside, they discovered several skewered bodies spread all over, and Glenna remarked again and again that whatever had happened there was not her fault. As they explored the oddly well preserved bodies, letters and other objects within, they gradually realized that they had entered a correctional facility for the mursaat's political prisoners, including not only [[human]]s but [[jotun]] and potentially [[Forgotten]] as well. Glenna continued with her gallows humor, irking the raiders, but she quickly explained that her quips were a coping mechanism to deal with the carnage around her.

After activating and defeating [[Mursaat Overseer|another mursaat construct]], they continued their investigation deeper into the facility while realizing that someone or something had to have caused the deaths of the inmates. They soon came across the culprit, the monstrous [[Samarog]], who held broken shackles and was accompanied by a human and a jotun prisoner, while the Eye of Janthir observed them from above. The raiders eventually bested Samarog and his minions who turned out to have been forced to fight on his behalf. The clues in the controlled minions' agonized cries led to Glenna speculating that Samarog had been an inmate promoted as the warden of the facility, and had been left to run it by his own standards after his mursaat masters' demise centuries ago. Glenna came to believe that the Eye was deeply involved with the facility, and also remarked about sensing celestial energy which might suggest the [[Veil (lore)|veil]] between Tyria and [[the Mists]] being thin there for some reason.

While Glenna stayed behind to explore her surroundings, the raiders pursued the Eye deeper into the facility, eventually entering [[Solitary Confinement]] where they met with an elderly human chained in place while the Eye hovered above him. Deciding to release him to ask some questions, the raiders broke the chains, only for the man to warn them about the consequences before a strange voice addressed them all with glee. A [[demon]]ic creature, [[Deimos]], entered the scene while relishing at torturing the prisoner's psyche and naming him [[Saul D'Alessio]], the famed founder of the White Mantle who had vanished centuries ago. The raiders defeated Saul's manifested sins as Deimos tried to break their spirits. As his power waned, Deimos ended up drawing the party into the [[Nayos|demonic realm]] in order to finish them off there. However, the demon was defeated for good when, against his expectations, Saul overcame his personal demons and joined the raiders' side. Following the demon's demise, the party returned to the physical realm. The victory was bittersweet, however, as Saul passed away soon after, finally freed from centuries of torment.

Glenna joined the raiders once the area had been secured, having listened to Saul's dying confession about the tortures he had lived through and how the Eye of Janthir had sustained him and the other inmates for centuries with its power to turn them into the mursaat's puppets. She postulated that the Eye disappearing after Deimos's defeat had ended its power over Saul, allowing the tortured man to finally pass away. She also reminded the raiders that as a scholar, she was well aware of history being more complicated than simplified depictions of good and evil, and that Saul had tried to reform himself in his later years to atone for his crimes. When the raiders suggested to keep Saul's presence in the bastion a secret from [[Kryta]]n authorities to not stir the kingdom while a present day [[Siege of Divinity's Reach|White Mantle crisis]] was ongoing, Glenna agreed with the assessment and promised to see to it that Saul's remains would be handled respectfully.

With the miasma surrounding the lower levels of the bastion clearing following Deimos's defeat and the Eye's departure, Glenna agreed that the raiders should explore the facility thoroughly to uncover more clues although she was hesitant to venture down as she was still recovering from the horrifying events she had witnessed in the facility. She also expressed regret that the Eye of Janthir had seemingly vanished for good as she would have wanted to study it to learn more about its connection to the mursaat and its origins.

=== [[Mount Balrior]] ===
Glenna was investigating what she called the "largos upset" when she heard about the [[Tyrian Alliance]] [[Balrior Peak|preparing]] to push against the recently emerged [[titan]]s on [[Mount Balrior]] in [[Janthir Syntri]] in 1337 <small>AE</small>. She dropped everything to shadow the event with the plan to observe the titans before alliance reinforcements would roll in and ruin any chance of direct observation. She learned from her [[Order of Whispers]] contact that the Pact Commander would also participate in the coming battle, and she pressured [[Steward Gixx]] to let her tag along. She organized a drop-off on the isle nearby from her partners at the [[Lion's Arch Aerodrome]]. One of the local [[Lowland Kodan]] showed her to the path, and she climbed the rest of the way herself.

After observing the titans and their spawn in secret, Glenna began speculating on why they differed so much from the titans of 250 years ago and who had relit the forge in the [[Foundry of Failed Creations]] to create more titans. She also realized how the titans were able to communicate with each other across distances via specific sounds and how the titans could use a more indetectable frequency of communication to shield their whereabouts. Using titan-related documents of fellow Priory scholar [[Farrah Baelseeker]] and her own equipment, Glenna was able to figure out which of the three titans each frequency belonged to. She managed to stay on Mount Balrior for seven hours before she was ambushed by titanspawn just as the Commander's party arrived.<ref>[[Glenna's Field Journal (Mount Balrior)]]</ref><ref>The [[Balrior Peak]] story chapter does not show the Pact Commander's party encountering Glenna on the way to the mountain camp whereas the [[Mount Balrior]] raid does not show the Commander's other named companions appearing among the raiders when they encounter Glenna. It thus remains unclear how canonical the appearance of Glenna and the raiders on Mount Balrior is supposed to be, if the Commander's interaction with Glenna and raiders simply happened off screen during the story chapter, or if the raid suggests that the three titans resurrected after being defeated in the story chapter and the raiders and Glenna assisted the Commander in a second battle against the titans afterwards. This article assumes that the Commander's encounter with Glenna was canonical at some point in the Janthir Wilds timeline.</ref>

After the raiders had rescued her from the ambushers, Glenna chatted with the Commander and expressed her delight in getting to work together again after their previous encounter. Promising to only observe and not interfere in the fights ahead, she informed the raiders about the dangers ahead and to stay careful. She also told them what she knew about the titans' origins and why she had traveled all the way to Janthir to begin with. Glenna admitted that her other reason for wanting to learn more about the titans was because of her personal investment in threads following Dhuum after the events in the Hall of Chains; if she found anything amiss, she would owe Desmina a warning despite having to figure out how to touch base with her.

As each titan was defeated in turn, Glenna provided the raiders with further commentary, speculating on who might have relit the forge in the Foundry of Failed Creations and for what purpose although it would be difficult to verify without entering the foundry in person to find more clues. As Glenna was reminded by the raiders mentioning the encounter with Gorseval back in Spirit Vale, she noted that there were similarities between Gorseval and the titans while hoping that the raiders would not run into a third nightmare as she would then have to amend her work-in-progress memoir. After [[Ura]] had been defeated as the last of the three titans, Glenna was eager to investigate the titan's corpse and compile more fodder for her eventual memoir.<ref>[[Scholar Glenna (Mount Balrior)#Dialogue]]</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Glenna is [[Voice actor|voiced]] by [[Megan Hollingshead]].<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/4sawvw/should_arenanet_be_communicating_more_this_column/d58jc6k Comment by Bobby Stein], Reddit.com</ref>
* Glenna was originally called Priory Scholar but was renamed in the [[Game updates/2016-03-08|March 8, 2016 patch]] after the [[Guild Wars 2 Raids Team]] decided to expand her role in the [[raid]]s. The change was not listed in the patch notes.
* She is the author of [[Glenna's Field Journal]] and its [[Glenna's Field Journal (Mount Balrior)|Mount Balrior variant]].

[[Tyrn Ironmaw]] is a vendor in [[Eye of the North]] that exchanges items for [[Tyrian Defense Seal]]s at a discounted rate once [[Great Champion]] in the [[Icebrood Saga mastery tracks|Dragon Slayer mastery line]] has been unlocked. There are three tiers to her offerings: Great Champion, [[Shining Champion]], and [[Dragon Slayer]]. The unlocks are cumulative adding new items to the previous tier's offerings.

== Notes ==
* Items may not be available every day. If the item you are seeking is not listed, check again after daily reset.
* The required [[Icebrood Saga mastery tracks#Dragon Slayer|Dragon Slayer]] [[mastery track]] is only unlocked after completing [[Tidings and Misgivings]], the second story step of [[Champions]]: [[Chapter 1: Truce]].
* The contents of the boxes vary by faction.
** All boxes may contain '''any''' of the [[Crafting_material#Common_crafting_materials|basic crafting materials]] (ore, wood, etc.) or [[Crafting_material#Intermediate_crafting_materials|trophies]] (blood, venom, etc.), but have different droprate distributions.
** With the exception of Skritt boxes, each faction may only contain one variety of [[Crafting_material#Advanced_crafting_materials|advanced crafting material]] (lodestones, cores, shards, etc.).
** {{item icon|Skritt Supply Box}} contain all advanced crafting material variants as well as [[junk item]]s.
** Boxes may rarely contain a {{item icon|Volcanic Stormcaller Weapon Box}}, {{item icon|Amalgamated Gemstone}}s, or {{item icon|Amalgamated Draconic Lodestone}}s.

In the Wizard's Tower, he is only visible after unlocking the [[Wayfinder Mastery]] whereas he appears normally in other locations. His inventory is also available via the [[Portable Wizard's Tower Exchange]].

== Dialogue ==
;In Hooligan's Route
:Hello, <Character name>! Got excess stuff on your hands? I can exchange it for shinies! I can also offer you the shiniest shiny I have, but...it's going to be very costly the first time you buy it.
:{{dialogue icon|sell}} ''You had me at shinies!'' <small>'''(Opens the vendor window)'''</small>
::Excellent. Here's what I have.
::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Stuff, stuff, stuff!''
:{{dialogue icon|collection}} ''Tell me about this "shiniest shiny."'' <small>'''(Opens the [[Gobblers and Exchanges Collector]] collection)'''</small>
::Why shop for gobblers and exchanges separately when you can access them from a single item? Don't worry, I know the services you're eligible for: I've got connections. Your inventory will thank you.
::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''That's a great idea!''
:{{dialogue icon|charisma}} ''Wow, that's quality armor.''
::Thanks. I like what you chose to wear today!
::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''Aw, thanks!''
:<small>'''(After having collected all memory essences for the [[Work Hard for Now]] collection)'''</small>
:{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Gharr, we found this artifact. We figured it is meant for you.''
::Hmm, that drawing... Why is it so familiar?
::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Drawing? I don't see anything.''
:::It was made for me to see. It is triggered by...are those memories? Those people look familiar...
:::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''It's not me, is it?''
::::Some of them look like you, though it's hard to tell. But the shorter figure by me is clearly in focus.
::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Continue to let Gharr examine the artifact.''
:::::A-ha! There's a message hidden in all of them. "You have to get better. You are all that I have." (You notice Gharr's eyes watering, but there's a faint glow of...magic?)
:::::{{dialogue icon|charisma}} ''Leadclaw, are you all right?''
::::::<Character name>, I'm scared. The message has changed, and It wants you to read the next phrase. I can't make it out, you have to do it. Please. (The artifact shows a [[skritt]] with a message for you to say.)
::::::{{dialogue icon|dignity}} ''"Don't take too long. You won't be here forever."''
:::::::You notice the faint glow in Gharr's eyes brighten for a few seconds, then return to normal. He's still a little teary-eyed, though.
:::::::{{dialogue icon|charisma}} ''Leadclaw?''
::::::::Commander, it all makes sense now. Those are memories from when I adventured around [[Central Tyria]] with a skritt. A dear friend of mine. We collected many curiosities, shinies included.
::::::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''(Continue to listen.)''
:::::::::It's not easy when your best friend comes down with some mysterious illness that [[Organizations#The Orders of Tyria|the Orders of Tyria]] don't have an answer for. But I kept up my hopes that I would find a cure.
:::::::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''(Continue to listen.)''
::::::::::Then one day, she was gone. Suppose I should have figured out there was something special about her. Not long after, the [[Astral Ward]] found me. They needed an expert in gathering items.
::::::::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''(Continue to listen.)''
:::::::::::I accepted the deal as a way to honor her and our legacy. But every item I gathered felt like a cruel reminder. The ward offered to make those memories dormant, but not to erase them.
:::::::::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''(Tilt your head in interest.)''
::::::::::::It was [[Krrsol]]'s idea. The way to reawaken my memories was through those phrases. They were our parting words. But I promise, not all of this is so morose, <Character name>.
::::::::::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''(Raise your eyebrow.)''
:::::::::::::She wanted me to discover this because she's found a place. A place she can continue being the Shiniest Shiny, just as we promised each other. [[The Mystic Forge]].
:::::::::::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Ah. I see.''
::::::::::::::It's thanks to you that I know where to visit her. You can keep the artifact. It seems it may have some powerful magical properties. I can always ask her for more.
::::::::::::::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I'm glad I could help, Gharr. Thank you for the gift.'' <small>'''(Rewards [[Proof of Eternal Skritt Friendship]], completing the collection)'''</small>
:::::::::::::::Take care of yourself, <Character name>. You're all you have.
:::::::::::::::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''You too, Gharr Leadclaw.''
:{{dialogue icon|more}} ''I think I'll save my shinies.''
::Fair enough. Enjoy your shinies. Thanks for stopping by. Take care of yourself and don't be a stranger, <Character name>.
::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Take it easy, Gharr.''

;In Lowland Shore
:<Character name>, it is nice to see you again. Hope you've been well. Care to trade any excess items for shinies?
:{{dialogue icon|sell}} ''Good to see you too, Leadclaw. Let's take a look at what you've got.'' <small>'''(Opens the vendor window)'''</small>
::You got it. Enjoy lightening your load a bit.
::{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Shinies! Perfect.'' <small>'''(Returns to the top of the dialogue)'''</small>
:<small>'''(After having collected all memory essences for the [[Work Hard for Now]] collection)'''</small>
:{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Gharr, we found this artifact. We figured it is meant for you.'' <small>'''(Same as above)'''</small>
:{{dialogue icon|charisma}} ''Wow, that's quality armor.''
::Thanks. It's a nice representation of Janthir, wouldn't you say? I appreciate what you chose to wear today as well, <Character name>.
::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''Aw, thanks!''
:{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Just stopping by to say hello.''
::Thanks for stopping by! Take care of yourself.
::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Take it easy.''

== Trivia ==
* After completing [[Work Hard for Now]], [[Krrsol]] will appear next to him at each location.

* At the Lion's Arch.
** He wears [[Council Ministry Mantle (skin)|Council Ministry Mantle]], [[Magus Coat (skin)|Magus Coat]], [[Illustrious Wristguards]], [[Ascalonian Performer Pants (skin)|Ascalonian Performer Pants]], and [[Conjurer Shoes (skin)|Conjurer Shoes]]. He wields a [[Whisperblade (skin)|Whisperblade]] and [[The Anomaly (skin)|The Anomaly]].

* At the Mythwright Gambit.
** He wears [[Requiem Coronet]], [[Perfected Envoy Mantle (skin)|Perfected Envoy Mantle]], [[Acclaimed Militia Chestpiece (light skin)|Acclaimed Militia Chestpiece]], [[Sun-Blessed Zephyrite Gloves (light skin)|Sun-Blessed Zephyrite Gloves]], [[Dapper Pants (light skin)|Dapper Pants]], and [[Slumbering Suffused Obsidian Light Shoes]]. He wields a [[Visage of the Mists (skin)|Visage of the Mists]].

* At the Dragon's Stand.
** He wears [[Leystone Cowl]], [[Chronomancer's Epaulets]], [[Bladed Vestments]], [[Experimental Envoy Gloves]], [[Ornate Guild Pants]] and [[Experimental Envoy Shoes]]. He wields an [[Augury of Death (skin)|Augury of Death]] and [[Horologicus (skin)|Horologicus]].
** When interacting with him, he'll extend one of his paws as though offering something before returning back to idling in a tinkering animation.

* At the Eye of the North.
** He wears [[Elegy Coronet]], [[Metal Legion "Tribune" Size|Metal Legion Band T-Shirt]], [[Elonian Gloves (skin)|Elonian Gloves]], [[Elegy Breeches]], and [[Funerary Shoes]]. He wields a [[Veilrender (skin)|Veilrender]] and [[Guide for the Lost (skin)|Guide for the Lost]].
** When interacting with him, he'll throw his head and arms back and out to the sides slightly as though surprised to be interrupted reading, before returning back to idling in the /readbook animation.

* At the Arborstone.
** He wears [[Light Monastery Headband|Monastery Headband]], [[Light Monastery Shoulderpads|Monastery Shoulderpads]], [[Jade Tech Vest]], [[Processing Line Control Bracers (light skin)|Processing Line Control Bracers]], [[Light Monastery Leggings|Monastery Leggings]], and [[Ancient Ritualist Shoes]]. He wields a [[Virtuoso's Dagger (skin)|Virtuoso's Dagger]] and [[Quietus (skin)|Quietus]].
** When interacting with him, he'll sip coffee.
** On initial release he was using the /facepalm emote animation, but it was later changed to the current animation of him holding a coffee cup.

* At the Wizard's Tower.
** He wears [[Suffused Obsidian armor (light)|Suffused Obsidian armor]]. He wields a [[Skyscale Rifle Skin|Skyscale Rifle]].
** When getting close to the [[Thornsprout Bloom]] next to Gharr, he'll say the line "Stay out of my cabbages!", the same line [[Kian (charr)|Kian]], the charr farmer in [[Sandswept Isles]] says, trying to warn the player of [[Thornsprout Boom!|what happens when one gets too close]].
** When interacting with him, he [[emote]]s /wave followed by /heroic; idling in the latter's end pose.

* At the Lowland Shore.
** He wears [[Woad Light Shoulders (skin)|Woad Shoulders]], [[Titanplate Light Regalia (skin)|Titanplate Regalia]], [[Woodland Kodan Leather Gloves (light)|Woodland Kodan Leather Gloves]], [[True Sight Light Leggings (skin)|True Sight Leggings]], and [[Polychromatic Light Shoes (skin)|Polychromatic Shoes]]. He wields a [[Klobjarne Geirr (skin)|Klobjarne Geirr]].
